title: Coventry put four past Newcastle to climb out of relegation zone
content: Coventry City picked up their first home victory in the Premier League for 25 years with an emphatic 4-1 win over Newcastle United on Monday.

title: Pedro Neto nets brace as Chelsea end Everton's unbeaten run
content: Pedro Neto scored twice in the second half to guide Chelsea to a 2-0 win at Everton on Saturday in a Premier League match marred by a serious-looking head injury to Chelsea goalkeeper Emi Martínez.

title: Alex Iwobi goal earns Alvaro Arbeloa's Fulham their first Premier League win
content: Fulham's winless run under Alvaro Arbeloa was finally ended by an entertaining 1-0 victory over Hull at Craven Cottage.

title: Erling Haaland brace helps Man City hold off Ipswich at defiant Etihad Stadium
content: Erling Haaland struck twice as defiant Manchester City marched on at the top of the Premier League by holding on for a 3-2 win over Ipswich.

title: Alexander Isak completes Liverpool comeback at nine-man Brentford
content: Alexander Isak marked his return from injury with the winner as Liverpool came from behind to beat nine-man Brentford 2-1.

title: Johan Manzambi fires Aston Villa to victory at St. James' Park
content: Johan Manzambi scored the only goal of the game as Aston Villa clinched a 1-0 win over Newcastle at St James' Park.

title: Dominic Calvert-Lewin denies Man United a first Premier League win since Aug. 30
content: Dominic Calvert-Lewin's second-half equaliser extended Manchester United's winless Premier League run to five matches as they were held 1-1 by rivals Leeds.

title: Five-goal Brighton run rampant over rivals Crystal Palace
content: Diego Gómez sensationally scored from the halfway line as Brighton struck three goals in the opening 10 minutes en route to thrashing bitter rivals Crystal Palace 5-0.

title: Bournemouth cruise to 2-0 win over 10-man Sunderland
content: Evanilson scored and contributed an assist as Bournemouth comfortably beat 10-man Sunderland 2-0 at the Vitality Stadium.

title: Noni Madueke sinks Nottingham Forest with Arsenal's only shot on target
content: Noni Madueke climbed off the bench to earn toothless Arsenal a 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest.
